Frosted tips. Boy band formations. That heartthrob energy that owned your middle school diary. 💌🎤

Cherry Pop is bringing the Kings out for one night only — Bieber, Timberlake, Backstreet Boys, and Big Time Rush all getting the tribute treatment on the Azucar stage. This is boy band nostalgia turned all the way up, drag-style, and it's happening THIS Sunday.

Grab your tickets before the good spots disappear. Your 2009 self is already screaming.

🗓️ Sunday, November 15 • Doors at 8pm
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🎟️ $10

Close your eyes. Hear that? That's a boy band harmony hitting the speakers and your heart doing a backflip. 🎶✨

Frosted tips catching the stage lights. Synchronized formations so sharp they could cut glass. Bieber swagger, Timberlake smoothness, Backstreet Boys drama, Big Time Rush chaos — Cherry Pop's Kings are bringing all of it to la pista, note for note, move for move.

It's the kind of night that feels like flipping through your middle school diary except now there's a drink in your hand and the bassline is unreal. Sweaty, loud, nostalgic, iconic.

Whether you had a Bieber poster, a BSB cassette, or a Big Time Rush crush you'll never admit to — this one's for you. 💖

No judgment here, just pure nostalgic chaos. Cherry Pop and the Kings are turning Azucar into a love letter to every boy band that ever lived rent-free in your head, and the whole Latinx community is invited to come scream the lyrics, dress the part, and lose it on la pista together.

Bring your best friend, your group chat, your ex who still has the matching friendship bracelet — everybody fits here. Come exactly as the fan you always were.

Cherry Pop presents an all-Kings lineup serving tributes to Bieber, Timberlake, Backstreet Boys, and Big Time Rush. Doors open at 8pm, tickets are $10, and this is the kind of night that sells out fast once word gets around.

Grab your tickets, round up your group, and get to Azucar early for the best spot on la pista.
